source_qualification: The calculations are real-source-derived but frame topology, loads and reinforcement are provisionally reconstructed; this is not an as-built model.

workflow.title: Source geometry
workflow.subtitle: Grid and report evidence
workflow.summary: 23 sourced column-grid marks; floor caption areas and material tables extracted. Floor outlines and storey classification remain unresolved.

workflow.title: Frame hypothesis
workflow.subtitle: Connectivity
workflow.summary: 92 nodes, 69 column segments and 96 candidate beams. Two explicitly hypothetical connectors were approved for calculations, not confirmed on site.

workflow.title: Column / footing
workflow.subtitle: M09 + foundations
workflow.summary: C24 material and demand reconstruction with reinforcement sensitivity; source F3 one-way shear is unsafe and remains open.

workflow.title: Gravity + ESM
workflow.subtitle: Signed force solve
workflow.summary: 19 signed load and combination cases; ~895 kN historical-source ULS ESM base-shear trial, no complete source FE equivalence.

workflow.title: Eccentricity / mass
workflow.subtitle: NBC 105 stiffness
workflow.summary: 153 3D-frame solves; gross, ULS and SLS stiffness, ±5% eccentricity, signed member-action envelopes and significant drift sensitivities.

workflow.title: Slab / wall / diaphragm
workflow.subtitle: Load path study
workflow.summary: 204 additional cases; source-grid tributary shares, source-coefficient wall-edge hypothesis and flexible-vs-rigid diaphragm extremes. Seismic weight remains unreconciled.

gate06.caveat: Each ratio is an elastic assumed frame chord estimate, ULS scaled by Rmu=4; not verified interstorey drift of the project.

caveats: Source floor area captions exist but physical slab polygons/openings are not mapped
Wall edge segments are inferred from convex hull of source grid, not from a measured wall plan
Rigid MPC trial constrains in-plane translations and rotations, not actual collector/slab stiffness
Wall trial increases assumed gravity load, but seismic lateral force still uses report W: added wall masses are not independently redistributed into ESM
No accepted P-Delta, CQC/RSA and building member design
